notes:
{死亡|しぼう} is a formal word for death, commonly used in official, medical, and news contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死亡|しぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to die - formal)
- {死亡|しぼう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (deceased person, fatalities)
- {死亡|しぼう}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧ (death notification/registration)
- {死亡|しぼう}⟦{診断書|しんだんしょ}→診断書：28447_shindansho⟧ (death certificate)
- {死亡|しぼう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (mortality rate)
- {死亡|しぼう}⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧ (cause of death)

SIMILAR WORDS (REGISTER DIFFERENCES):
- {死亡|しぼう}: death (formal, official, medical)
- ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧: death (literary, philosophical)
- ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: to pass away (polite, euphemistic)
- ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧: to die (neutral to casual)

REGISTER: Formal. Used in news, documents, and medical contexts.
